description: Find all event handlers that subscribe to events on a D365 table or class. Searches the knowledge base for [SubscribesTo(classStr(objectName), ...)] / [SubscribesTo(tableStr(objectName), ...)] attribute patterns. Use eventName to narrow results to a specific event (e.g. 'OnInserted'). WHEN: 'who handles X', 'what subscribes to Y', 'event handlers for Z', 'qui écoute l'événement', 'abonnés à l'événement', 'SubscribesTo', 'data events for'.

eventName.description: Optional: filter to a specific event name, e.g. 'OnInserted', 'OnUpdated', 'OnDeleted', 'OnValidatingWrite'.

handlerType.description: Optional: filter by handler type — 'DataEventHandler' or 'PrePostEventHandler'.

objectName.description: Table or class name to find event handlers for, e.g. 'SalesTable', 'PurchTable'.

name: find_event_handlers
